# FC04 MSE P32 ingress scope amendment

This is a narrow correction to P31 v0.4, not a new Phase 2 design. Baseline P32 revision `a6b68e36dacd95b64d9e23586c271db87edc901a` already contains the separately verified stale-control guard. Preserve that work, the accepted D06-B policy, v0.4 oracles and the user-approved preparer self-review policy.

The v0.4 package allows `runtime/control/include/canvas/control/canvas_control_service.hpp` and `runtime/composition/src/canvas_runtime_facade.cpp`, but omitted the actual unified ingress variant declared in `runtime/composition/include/canvas/runtime/canvas_runtime_facade.hpp` and dispatched in `runtime/composition/src/canvas_runtime_text.cpp`. `submitCanvasControl` enqueues in the control service then places work in `CanvasRuntimeFacade::ingress_`; `processIngress` owns ordering, TextEdit finish/defer and owner-pump dispatch. Adding an independent second pump or encoding a typed request in an unrelated existing payload would break the frozen design.

Additionally allow only these two existing files, locked by `source-lock.json`, for a private typed multi-selection work variant and its ordered dispatch. Keep `RuntimeFacade` virtual interface, C ABI, existing public runtime control structs, wire formats, canonical operations, and SDK locks unchanged. This amendment does not make any C++ ABI change acceptable where it violates the original user-approved scope; rebuild internal static consumers together and stop if a separately supported stable C++ ABI is identified.

The new work follows the existing bounded ingress ordering, request identity, owner-thread, close/destroy, duplicate/expiry and text-completion/defer semantics. Its control-service entry and ingress marker must be admitted or rejected together, so allocation failure or queue saturation never leaves orphaned work. Precommit validation and D07 prepare/History/Scene reservations still precede canonical publication. Typed receipts remain owned and bounded, with no result fabricated in the UI. If the exact implementation cannot preserve these invariants without other unallowed owners, stop and report rather than extend silently.

Add real-owner tests for ordering of TextInput, multi-edit and subsequent controls; native composition still active/deferred and rejected completion; close/target destroy; duplicate IDs; both queue capacity/failure cases; stale selection/semantic/Scene; exactly one commit/Undo; and zero Document/Scene/History/redo mutation on rejection. Retain v0.4 MSE-01..27, its full inherited regressions, Windows, actual Chrome/WASM, and TextEdit/IME obligations. These tests are NOT_RUN until actually executed. The known Protobuf/Abseil OOM blocker is not waived.

The user requested continued Phase 2 implementation and explicitly accepted preparer self-review of the P31 corrections on 2026-10-29. This record does not claim independent review, product completion, final Gate, PHYS, merge, or release readiness.
